# Vendored browser libraries for the tutor skill (loaded by pages that
# scripts/render.py makes). Every file below was extracted unmodified from the
# npm registry tarball named in its section. render.py copies this folder to
# <page folder>/_assets/ and copies it again whenever this file changes, so
# update this file (versions and checksums) whenever a library is upgraded.
#
# Verify:  cd .claude/skills/tutor/assets/vendor && grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{64}  ' VERSIONS.txt | sha256sum -c
